**Objectives of the Tutorial/Lab**
By the end of this tutorial, you should be able to:

- Show whether a given distribution belongs to the exponential family.
- Fit a Poisson regression model for count data.
- Visualise the final model and access whether it supports the conclusion.

## Question 1

The binomial random variable $Y \sim \text{bin}(m, p)$ for known $m$ (not a parameter) has mass function:
$$
f(y; p) = {m \choose y} p^y (1-p)^{m-y} \text{ for } y = 0, 1, \ldots, m.
$$
Show that the binomial distribution is an exponential family.
